saw_lines: Luxury fashion buyers rarely commit after a quick look. They want to see the piece move and compare it with rivals.
So the sale is lost in seconds, when a shopper sees a still photo with no proof and moves on.
Your 30 ads contain 0 videos, so buyers never see the product move. Shoot short videos of it in use and test them against your oldest ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads is a video, so buyers never see the product move before they decide. Shoot short videos of the Belstaff Phoenix capsule in use, then test them against your 28 ads that have run 60+ days.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the brand over a rival store. Collect a real figure, such as orders shipped, and open the next Munich ad with it.
4 of your 15 copy ads open on the same Munich line, so the account repeats one idea. Test new angles against it, such as the Düsseldorf store or the beauty room booking, and keep the best.
None of your 15 copy ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in the opening line of each new ad, starting with the Belstaff Phoenix capsule.

ads_1: Short videos and first order offer openers, tested against the Munich opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
